narrative_purpose: Makes the two propulsion systems visible on one body: a broad low-cost flapping wing surface on one side, and a small high-pressure nozzle fed by a muscular cavity on the other.
subject: A single large squid-ray animal seen from directly above, its body opened as a naturalist cutaway along the centre line. On the left half the wing is intact and whole, shown mid-downstroke as a broad curved muscular sheet with long parallel muscle fibre bands running out toward its pointed tip. On the right half the body wall is cut away to reveal a large hollow internal cavity lined with thick circular and radial muscle bands, narrowing at the rear into a short smooth funnel nozzle that opens through the flank. A thin stream of water is shown leaving that nozzle as a narrow tapering jet. The head with its four eyes and twelve tentacles is intact at the front of the frame.
scene: Neutral dark open water with no background objects, the animal isolated as a specimen plate.
camera: Straight-on overhead plan view, flat and naturalist cutaway, the whole animal filling the frame front to back.
light: Even soft cool illumination from above with no strong shadow; faint cyan glow inside the exposed muscular cavity; the intact wing lit slightly warmer than the cutaway side.
palette: Deep teal and indigo body tones, muted stone-grey muscle bands, cyan glow in the cavity interior, one amber accent on the nozzle opening.
style: Hand-painted anatomical cutaway plate in a naturalist field-guide idiom, painterly not vector.
detail_level: High detail on the muscle fibre banding, the cavity lining and the nozzle throat; plain dark water surrounding the whole animal framed by deep negative space.
composition: Bilateral split with the intact wing on the left and the cutaway cavity and nozzle on the right, animal centred, wide plain dark margins on all four sides.
consistency_notes: Same animal as fig-00-cover: four eyes, twelve tentacles, ray-like wings. The nozzle is biological tissue, never a machine part. Both halves are the same individual, not two specimens.
negative_prompt: no text, no labels, no arrows, no metal machinery, no turbine blades, no infographic panels, no photographic or 3D-render look, no cartoon style
